name: COMP_011
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (42%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged reliability [F6], three-class ambiguity, and frozen-section margins require permanent sections and recut review [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 42%, Benign 30%, InSitu 23%, Normal 5% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Split across three classes |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage) [F1] | Cannot separate benign from malignant |
| Reliability / OOD | 20% reliability (flagged), 94th percentile OOD (AUROC 70%) | Unreliable, atypical input image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (models disagree) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive (3 Normal, 1 InSitu, 1 Benign) [F5] | Neighbors contradict invasive call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 3, 5) · ↓ invasive · Strongest benign push (-0.843) [F2], but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical infiltration (+0.399) in high-risk regions [F3] (19/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical duct confinement (+0.311) lowers non-invasive support [F4] (12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical benign stroma (-0.272) in zero-risk regions (20/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops score more than random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Composite frozen-section quality issues distort regions 8–11; a drafted recut H&E section may resolve artifacts.
- Regions 8–11 are in situ or benign atypia on deeper levels, matching non-invasive neighbors (BACH_0076 Normal, 89% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 10, 11**: Highest risk (57%–100%); verify stromal invasion versus in situ atypia on deeper levels.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 3, 5**: Zero-risk regions; confirm benign lobules and stroma (normal-lobules concept is unreliable, 0/20).
3. **Regions 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11**: Inspect inferior, medial, and lateral margins (99%–100%); defer frozen call to permanents.
